remarks: Beautifully 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath Country Colonial in the highly sought-after Starpoint School District! Situated on a spacious 125' x 195' fully fenced lot with shed.  This move-in-ready home blends country charm with modern updates. Highlights include new laminate flooring throughout home, rich natural woodwork, bay windows, crown molding, a dramatic vaulted family room and brick fireplace with gas insert, and an Updated eat-in kitchen featuring quartz countertops, a walk-in pantry, and French doors leading to a newer Trex deck with Kohler awning. The oversized primary bedroom offers a beamed cathedral ceiling with the room to possibly add a master bath, while the loft overlooking the family room provides the perfect space for a home office or reading nook. Lots of windows lots of natural light.  Remodeled baths, a finished basement rec room, first-floor laundry, central A/C, abundant storage, and a fully insulated 3-bay garage add exceptional functionality. Relax on the inviting wraparound porch and enjoy the privacy of the large backyard in this quiet, family-friendly neighborhood. A rare combination of space, comfort, and convenience!
